executionHistory.summary: Implemented SCOPE-028-02 (Versioned Decision Diagnostic Projection) for real: buildDiagnosticProjection(decision, projectionState, diagnostic) and projectModelAssumptionConflict(diagnostic) were added additively inside the existing rlvol.js UMD closure directly after the SCOPE-028-01 buildRoughnessDiagnostic and directly before the unchanged projectVolToolRead owner-read block, and exported alongside (never replacing) every pre-existing export. baseDecision is the exact frozen rlvol-decision-read/v1 object reference the caller supplies (never cloned or re-serialized); buildDiagnosticProjection includes a defense-in-depth runtime self-check that throws RLVOL_DIAGNOSTIC_PROJECTION_BASE_DECISION_MUTATED if the wrapped decision's object identity, key set, or canonical bytes ever differ after wrapping. projectModelAssumptionConflict emits zero conflicts unless the diagnostic is supported and its classification is strictly below-0.5 or above-0.5 (never on indistinguishable-from-0.5), and the one conflict it can emit is non-blocking, wrapper-owned, and free of directional trading language (regex-verified in every test). New tests added to the existing tests/rlvol-roughness.unit.mjs (5 new tests, one existing weak classification test upgraded to drive the real buildRoughnessDiagnostic path with fabricated finalized-bootstrap boundaries instead of literal comparisons) and tests/volatility-roughness.integration.mjs (3 new tests using a real buildVolDecisionRead() decision and a real Scope-1 formula pipeline) all pass, covering SCN-028-008, 009, 010, and 013 including the exact strict-outside/inclusive-containment classification boundary (both endpoints and interior containment), base-decision byte/key-set/object-reference invariance across all five wrapper/diagnostic-state combinations, a rigid-parser canary proving the wrapper is never misparsed as a v1 decision, and proof that the unchanged projectVolToolRead() continues to consume only projection.baseDecision. An additive SCOPE-028-02 canary group was added to scripts/selftest.mjs (4 assertions, all passing) using a real production-path decision. executionHistory.summary: Started SCOPE-028-03 (Power Evaluation UI and Accessibility) with SUB-PASS 1 OF 2 ONLY, additively in volatility-sizing-lab.html (rlvol.js untouched by this sub-pass): a native #roughnessEnable checkbox and a persistent role=status #roughnessStatus region were added to the Power view between the existing sizing-evidence card and the provenance card; a runtime.roughness state record (enabled, pageState restricted to the design's fixed disabled|computing|cancelled|stale-result union, stage, evaluationToken, sourceKey, snapshot, bootstrapState, diagnostic, projection, invocationCount) was added to the existing runtime object and exposed read-only through the pre-existing window.VolSizingLab.runtime getter. enableRoughness() deep-clones and deep-freezes the CURRENT already-hydrated runtime.bars (the exact object readCachedBars() produced during the page's own existing cache-first paint) plus source metadata, derives a sourceKey, and queues cooperative work with setTimeout(fn,0); it calls hydrate()/RLDATA.ensureBars()/fetch() nowhere, verified both by code inspection and by a zero-bar-request Playwright assertion. The scheduler runs the cheap proxy+per-order+common-fit stage synchronously via RLVOL's own exported buildObservedLogVolPath/buildStructureFunctions/fitScalingExponent/fitCommonH (no reimplemented formula math), then only if the common fit admits hands off to an incremental bootstrap loop using RLVOL.startRoughnessBootstrap/stepRoughnessBootstrap (batches of at most 25 resamples per zero-delay task) /finalizeRoughnessBootstrap/buildRoughnessDiagnostic, each stage validated against runtime.roughness.evaluationToken/sourceKey before being adopted so a disablement or re-enablement discards in-flight work rather than adopting it as canonical evidence. Six new Playwright tests were added additively to tests/volatility-sizing-lab.spec.mjs (real route via startStaticServer, zero page.route/interception): the exact-title TP-028-03-01 test 'Regression: SCN-028-002 keeps first paint and provider activity unchanged until enablement' (disabled-by-default runtime state, zero invocationCount, zero bar requests across a Simple<->Power switch); the exact-title TP-028-03-03 test 'Regression: Scope 1 formula and admission outcomes remain visible after Power projection wiring' plus a companion unavailable-state test, proving the pre-existing Scope 1 production formulas are unaffected by this wiring; and two supplementary implementation-correctness tests (not persistent TP rows) proving the enable path actually freezes a real snapshot and completes a real incremental bootstrap end to end (invocationCount 1, projectionState available, bootstrap fully stepped), and that disabling mid-flight cancels and discards the result (invocationCount stays 0, diagnostic stays null) after a 500ms settle window. All 6 new tests pass; the full tests/volatility-sizing-lab.spec.mjs file (34 tests) passes with zero regressions; node scripts/selftest.mjs shows 3503 passed, 3 failed — the same 3 pre-existing, unrelated failures already documented in the SCOPE-028-02 entry above, confirmed unchanged. NOT implemented in this sub-pass, explicitly deferred to sub-pass 2: accessible evidence rendering (threshold ledger, structure-function/benchmark charts, same-data semantic tables, exclusion ledger, replay disclosure, QuantitativeFinance handoff), the Simple-view compact notice, 320px/200%-zoom responsive behavior, and TP-028-03-02/04/05/06. Also not yet wired: asset/history-change diagnostic-identity invalidation (design.md's 'retain enablement but invalidate the diagnostic identity' clause) — today only explicit enable/disable toggling is covered. No DoD checkbox for Scope 3 is ticked in scopes.md; Scope 3 status is set to 'In Progress', explicitly NOT Done. rlshock.js and other shock-transmission files were not touched, per instruction to avoid conflicting with concurrent unrelated work on those files.
